name: Jones Creek Apparel
old_description: Since 2010, Jones Creek Apparel has been Central Iowa's trusted partner for custom apparel — built on honest pricing, in-house production, and the kind of personal service that other vendors simply don't offer.
about:
Jones Creek Apparel opened in 2010 in Winterset, Iowa, with a commitment to provide custom apparel backed by personal service that larger vendors could not match. The company operates from its own facility and also serves the Des Moines metro through a sub-brand, Waukee Ink.

The shop produces screen printing, embroidery, and direct-to-film (DTF) printing entirely in-house, while sublimated jerseys and promotional products are sourced through partners but held to the same quality standard. The company decorates garments from brands such as Nike, Under Armour, New Era, and Gildan, and states it handles orders ranging from six pieces to 600 pieces with the same attention.

Clients include businesses, schools, sports teams, and organizations across Central Iowa. Examples cited by the company include Farmers & Merchants State Bank and various local teams and small businesses seeking corporate uniforms, team apparel, event giveaways, and corporate gifts.

Jones Creek Apparel emphasizes honest pricing with no setup fees, complimentary graphic design, and a transparent process from garment selection to final proof. The company says its differentiator is consistent, hands-on care regardless of order size, delivered by the same team that produces the work.

about:
Jones-McLeod, Inc. is a third-generation family-owned business founded in 1949 in Birmingham, Alabama. The company began as a small appliance repair operation and has remained under family control through three generations.

From three Alabama locations — Birmingham, Mobile, and Montgomery — it supplies parts for commercial cooking, warewashing, and ice machines, and provides both on-site and in-shop repair services. It operates a fleet of service trucks for on-site repairs and also stocks foodservice chemicals.

Its customers include restaurants, hotels, and institutional kitchens throughout Alabama and the Florida Panhandle that rely on commercial cooking, warewashing, and ice machine equipment.

The company emphasizes its multi-location footprint as a way to deliver fast, quality service across its territory, a capability built on its evolution from a local repair shop to a regional distributor.

name: KAM Plastics Corp
old_description: KAM Plastics Corp is a manufacturer of injection molded components and subassemblies.  Our products are used in automotive (Tier 2 or lower), furniture, military and recreational vehicle applications, to name a few. External and internal issues, including interested parties (and customer requirements) that are relevant to KAM and our QMS are identified in our One Page Planning process.  Product warranty is currently not required by our customers.
about:
KAM Plastics Corp was founded in 1994 in Holland, Michigan, by Paul Kalkman and Cleon Morgan. The company became employee-owned through an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in 2004, reaching full employee ownership by 2012 after the founders retired.

The company specializes in plastic injection molding and assembly, operating over 50 molding machines across facilities in Holland, Michigan, and Arteaga, Mexico (via the KAMEX joint venture). Capabilities include two-shot molding, insert molding, and value-added processes such as chrome plating, painting, and pad printing. A product development and launch team supports customers from concept through production.

KAM serves automotive (Tier 2 and below), furniture, military, recreational vehicle, and consumer product markets. Early projects included the Ford Roll Up Window Handle (1995) and the Ford Ground Illumination Light Module (2000), and the company notes its parts can be found on products from U.S. companies.

The company emphasizes solving complex molding challenges — "We do the hard stuff" — and cites its employee-ownership culture, quality systems (IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001), and tools like CMM inspection, 3D scanning, and 8D problem solving as differentiators.

name: KCM Cable and Manufacturing
old_description: KCM Cable & Manufacturing is a fantastic resource for any company seeking custom cable production. KCM provides valuable insight for cable optimization and DFM with their experience and feedback. They produce high-quality custom cables, are prompt to respond with quotes and scheduling, and will be a significant asset for any company at any phase of the cable manufacturing process. I highly recommend working with KCM Cable & Manufacturing.
about:
KCM Cable & Manufacturing operates from Tooele, Utah, about forty minutes west of Salt Lake City. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces wire harnesses and cable assemblies covering power, signal, coaxial, and RF configurations across a wide range of connector families — from military-spec circulars (MIL-DTL-38999, 5015, 26482) to industrial, board-level, and automotive connectors. Work flows from prototype and first-article builds through repeat production, with in-house cutting, crimping, shield termination, routing, testing to IPC/WHMA-A-620 classes, and documentation. Facility size and headcount are not published.

Customers span aerospace and defense, space and satellite, robotics and autonomy, medical devices, semiconductor and test equipment, data center and power infrastructure, industrial and energy, agriculture and heavy equipment, marine and subsea, mining, and automotive aftermarket. The company also accepts inquiries from any sector that requires wired interconnects.

KCM emphasizes hands-on manufacturing paired with organized processes and clear communication, aiming to make complex cable work easier to understand, quote, and build. It offers design input at the quote stage, accepts customer-supplied or consigned material, and welcomes facility visits.

name: KG Sheet Metal Services, LLC
old_description: KG Sheet Metal offers a wide variety of custom fabrication and installations. Our 30,000 SF facility allows us to produce the high-end products our customers require. Our union certified craftsmen utilize state-of-the-art equipment to handle all of your sheet metal needs both large and small.
about:
KG Sheet Metal Services, LLC is a commercial sheet metal contractor based in Upper Marlboro, Maryland. Founded in 2002 by Kevin Grenier, who began his sheet metal career in 1985, the company grew from a basement shop into one of the Washington, D.C. area's most reliable commercial sheet metal contractors. It is a family-owned business, with Grenier as owner and president, later joined by co-owners Chris Berry (VP of Project Management) and Wes Willis (VP of Estimating).

The company provides custom fabrication and installation of sheet metal from a 30,000-square-foot facility. Its capabilities include ductwork and accessories, all-welded duct systems in galvanized, stainless, black iron, and aluminum, flues and breaching installation, FRP installation, certified fire damper inspections, duct air leakage testing, custom design-build assist, custom welding, and CADD/Autodesk 3D modeling. A dedicated Small Projects/Services Department handles expedited design, fabrication, and installation for smaller or emergency jobs. Union-certified Local 100 craftsmen perform the work using state-of-the-art equipment.

KG Sheet Metal serves government, industrial, and commercial clients. Project examples include the University of Maryland, Amtrak, Fort George G. Meade, the Washington Monument, Smithsonian National Zoological Park, Martin Luther King Jr. Elementary, Smithsonian National Air & Space Museum, The Mayflower Hotel, Virginia Hospital Center, and Walter Reed Military Medical Center. The firm works across hospitality, healthcare, military installations, government buildings, schools and universities, transportation, and national landmarks, often partnering with mechanical and general contractors.

The company emphasizes honest, expert, and expedient service, aiming to exceed expectations on every project. Its coordination team uses Autodesk software to create 3D models that catch issues early, and most projects are drawn and fabricated in-house to streamline installation. KG Sheet Metal has won multiple craftsmanship awards and highlights its ability to respond quickly through the Small Projects/Services Department, which was expanded in 2016 by merging with West Sheet Metal.

name: Kalsec
old_description: Since 1958, Kalsec has provided personalized service, consistently high-quality products, & innovative ingredients & solutions for our customers seeking the best in natural taste, colors, food protection & hop products for the food & beverage industry.
about:
Kalsec was founded in 1958 in Kalamazoo, Michigan, by Paul H. Todd, Jr., who declared, "We hold nature in awesome respect." The company remains family-owned and began as Vegetone Color Systems, pioneering custom natural color combinations and early use of gas-liquid chromatography for spice extraction.

Today Kalsec produces natural food and beverage ingredients across four platforms: natural colors, taste and sensory solutions, food protection, and hop products under the KalHops brand. Its vertically integrated supply chain runs from seed to shelf, supported by a global network of research, finishing, and distribution sites including the Don Berdahl Center for New Technology in Kalamazoo, the SPICE Lab at Wageningen University, and a new Spice Processing Center in Michigan. The company operates analytical labs equipped with gas chromatography–mass spectrometry and a patented vacuum fractionation process for hop oils.

Kalsec serves the food and beverage industry, with documented applications in beverages, fats and oils, flavors and seasoning blends, meat and poultry, noodles, pickles, plant-based proteins, refrigerated and prepared foods, sauces/dressings/condiments, and snacks. Its customers range from large global brands to craft brewers seeking consistent hop aroma and bitterness.

The company's stated purpose is "unlocking the potential of people, nature & science to nourish the world." As a certified B Corp, it emphasizes social and environmental standards alongside its family-ownership model, positioning its vertically integrated supply chain and sensory expertise (Spectrum Method-trained panel) as key differentiators.

Kapa Foods, based in Webster, Massachusetts, has been family-owned and operated since 1985. The company began as a wholesale food supplier serving local businesses in the region.

The distributor sources fresh meat, seafood, and produce daily from Boston's wholesale market and delivers directly to customers using its own six-truck fleet. It offers same-day delivery with no delivery fee, supplying a broad range of products including fresh and frozen meats, seafood, dairy, produce, dry goods, cleaning supplies, and paper goods.

Kapa Foods serves restaurants, supermarkets, caterers, schools, hotels, nursing homes, golf courses, catering companies, churches, festivals, social clubs, special events, and flea markets throughout the area.

The company emphasizes freshness and customer experience, highlighting daily market pickups, accurate order fulfillment, and fast turnaround as key differentiators in a competitive food-service supply market.

about:
Kapital Electric, Inc. is a locally owned and operated renewable energy contractor based in Bensenville, Illinois. Founded in 2009, the company has served the Chicago metropolitan area, Northwest Indiana, and Northern Illinois for over a decade.

The firm specializes in turnkey solar photovoltaic installations, electric vehicle charger deployment, battery storage systems, and virtual power plant integration. Its service portfolio also includes ice-melting equipment installation, smart home automation, and electrical service upgrades. Kapital Electric manages the full project lifecycle — from free onsite evaluation and permitting through inspection and commissioning — and offers 24-hour emergency support for solar customers.

The company works with both residential and commercial clients. Homeowners in the Chicagoland suburbs engage Kapital Electric for rooftop arrays, garage EV chargers, and whole-house battery backup. Commercial customers include businesses seeking to offset energy costs with solar and storage. The firm’s project references cite installations for individual condos, single-family homes, and commercial facilities across DeKalb County and the broader region.

Kapital Electric distinguishes itself by using American-made solar panels, handling all permitting and inspections in-house, and providing free estimates. The company emphasizes ownership over leasing to capture federal and state tax incentives, and it promotes a straightforward installation process backed by a 24-hour emergency service line for solar customers.
